Теперішні часи для майбутнього, Future C: Present tenses for the future, Future Continuous and Future Perfect
Про майбутнє можна говорити й без просто: You can talk about the future without plain will: Present Continuous for arrangements, Present Simple for timetables. There is also Future Continuous (will be doing) for an action that will be in progress at a certain moment, and Future Perfect (will have done) for something that will already be finished by a certain moment.

Future Continuous: дія буде в процесі в: Future Continuous: an action in progress at a certain moment

Future Continuous: ввічливо питаємо про: Future Continuous: asking politely about someone’s plans
